name: coding-cube-spike-build
description: Builds the linux/arm64 Coding Cube spike image and pushes it to ECR. Only needed when there is no local container builder; each cycle is minutes rather than seconds.

source.buildspec:
version: 0.2

phases:
  pre_build:
    commands:
      - aws ecr get-login-password --region "$AWS_DEFAULT_REGION" | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin "$ACCOUNT_ID.dkr.ecr.$AWS_DEFAULT_REGION.amazonaws.com"
  build:
    commands:
      - docker build --platform linux/arm64 -f spike/Dockerfile -t "$ECR_REPO:$IMAGE_TAG" .
      - SIZE=$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Size}}' "$ECR_REPO:$IMAGE_TAG"); echo "image bytes $SIZE"; test "$SIZE" -lt 1932735283
      - docker tag "$ECR_REPO:$IMAGE_TAG" "$ACCOUNT_ID.dkr.ecr.$AWS_DEFAULT_REGION.amazonaws.com/$ECR_REPO:$IMAGE_TAG"
      - docker push "$ACCOUNT_ID.dkr.ecr.$AWS_DEFAULT_REGION.amazonaws.com/$ECR_REPO:$IMAGE_TAG"
